description: Money-free world state after PERSON-0 (the town's persons: names, births, deaths, offices, save v16) for the in-repo cases, from scripts/ledgerBalanceTrace.ts . <case> <ticks> [state]. finalWorldHashWithoutMoney is canonicalStateHash of the final state without treasuryCoin, coinLedger, ledger, money, history and Building.upkeepUnpaid. PERSON-0 changes the world by design (the state records persons; mortality takes residents where a house cannot grow, spec PS-3), so the F0-C1 world no longer applies. The cache must still match the ledger on every tick. MARKET-1 re-pinned seed1City2400 (the market reaches homes along the road; the new-game case is unchanged). MARKET-1 MK-5 re-pinned it again: the trace runs the bot, and AR-5 now lays a road (44,43) that brings four lived-in L4 homes into the markets' reach where it used to demolish one of them (the rules are unchanged; at the merge before MK-5 the hash was 67db5f18). FIX-4 re-pinned newGame10000: the new game opens with 60d and 160 timber, and upkeep is charged food chain first with old debt no longer idling a facility (spec HR-1, HR-2, HR-3, HR-9); seed1City2400 is unchanged.
